titleEn: From Data Overload to Actionable Insights: How AI Is Transforming Agronomy
titleZh: 从数据过载到可执行洞察：AI如何变革农艺学
summaryZh: 本文报道了CropLife在Tech Hub LIVE 2026大会上对Growmark的Brendan Bachman的炉边对话，探讨AI如何帮助农资零售商和农艺师将多年积累的农场数据转化为更好的决策和种植者成果。内容涵盖从大数据到AI驱动洞察的演变、Growmark的MyFS Agronomy平台开发，以及AI如何帮助农艺师更快分析数据、创建定制报告并将更多时间用于为种植者创造价值。
featuredReason: 虽然本文聚焦于大田作物领域的农艺AI应用，但其关于如何将海量农场数据转化为可执行洞察、以及AI辅助农艺师提升决策效率的核心思路，对智慧畜牧行业在数据驱动养殖管理和AI辅助决策方面具有直接的借鉴意义。
contentFull:
By CropLife 

 

 Share

 

 

 

 

 

 How can AI help ag retailers and agronomists turn years of accumulated farm data into better decisions and stronger grower outcomes? In this Fireside Chat at Tech Hub LIVE 2026, Eric Sfiligoj of CropLife Media Group sits down with Brendan Bachman of Growmark to discuss how artificial intelligence is changing agronomy. They explore the evolution from big data to AI-powered insights, the development of Growmark’s MyFS Agronomy platform, and how AI is helping agronomists analyze data faster, create customized reports, and focus more time on delivering value to growers.
